title: BESS firm Energy Vault breaks ground on first data center in Snyder, Texas
summary: Energy Vault and Crusoe have launched their first data center in Snyder, Texas, marking a significant step towards sustainable energy solutions.

# BESS firm Energy Vault breaks ground on first data center in Snyder, Texas


Energy Vault | 1 August 2026


Battery energy storage firm Energy Vault has broken ground on its first data center, in partnership with AI data center developer Crusoe.
